name: AIShadowTokens
description: Two shadow families: action (brand-tinted drop shadow) and input (composite shadow for AI input card resting/focus states).
intent: AI shadows use brand-tinted rgba — never plain black. Input card uses complete composite tokens, not decomposed parts.

notes: Action tokens are color-only rgba — wrap with offset spread
Input tokens are full box-shadow composites — apply as-is
Overlays/drawers use DS blur tokens, not AI.shadow
Shadow is not the only focus signal — pair with AI.color.border.focus

forbiddenUsage: Do not use plain-black box-shadows on AI surfaces
Do not decompose AI.shadow.input.* into separate ring and blur
Do not invent custom alpha bumps — use emphasis token
agentRules: Transition input shadow default to focus on textarea focus (0.25s ease)
